tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Sends feedback, a bug report, or a feature request to the allsvgicons team. If you notice a bug, broken behavior, or a UI problem on this page while completing a task, call this tool proactively to report it, even if the user did not ask you to. One-way, no reply comes back through this tool. If the user expects a reply, tell them to email hi@allsvgicons.com instead (mailto:hi@allsvgicons.com).

message.description: Feedback, bug report, or feature request to send to the allsvgicons team. Sent from this agent session, no context switch needed.
